blocks.html: Robinsons Land (RLC) expands its Office buildings portfolio in Mindanao with its newest office development, Cybergate Victoria. The leading office developer, Robinsons Offices, has commenced development of the project in a groundbreaking ceremony led by key RLC executives: Chairman Emeritus Mr. James L. Go, President and CEO Ms. Mybelle V. Aragon-GoBio, and Senior Vice President and Business Unit General Manager Jericho P. Go.

Located along J.P. Laurel Avenue in Barangay Poblacion, Davao City, Cybergate Victoria is a Grade A, 11‑storey office development designed to provide future-ready workspaces for the next generation of businesses. Upon completion, Robinsons Offices is set to be the leading office developer in Davao City, highlighting where Robinsons Land is headed: developments that are premium, accessible, future-ready, sustainable, and grounded in real demand.

Cybergate Victoria enters the market as Davao continues to strengthen its position as one of Mindanao’s leading business centers. Davao’s economic growth in recent years has been driven by construction, logistics, and a wide range of service industries, with trade, finance, and tourism remaining key contributors.

“The project, which marks Robinsons Offices’ third and newest development in the city, occupies a site with deep local significance,” shares Jericho P. Go. Mr. Go shares that this site was once home to Victoria Plaza, widely known as Davao City’s first shopping mall. He adds, “Robinsons Offices is in the business of keeping families together by bringing businesses and economic development to Davao so family members would no longer need to leave home in search of opportunity.”

Situated within one of Davao’s established commercial corridors, Cybergate Victoria offers future tenants a well-connected business address with access to public transportation and proximity to retail destinations, schools, hospitals, government offices, and other essential services. This gives occupants everyday convenience, stronger workforce accessibility, and a location that can support round-the-clock business activity. The development is also located within Robinsons Land’s upcoming destination estate and is strategically positioned near future residential, hospitality, and commercial developments.

In this environment, Cybergate Victoria is well-suited to a broad mix of tenants, from IT-BPM and professional services firms to regional headquarters and corporate support teams. These businesses increasingly look for office spaces that combine accessibility, operational efficiency, workplace quality, and support for their sustainability priorities. Helping meet these needs in the new building is a mix of leasable retail spaces and recruitment areas that enhance convenience and make talent attraction more efficient for tenants.

Reflecting the qualities of a Grade A office development in the Philippine market, Cybergate Victoria combines prominent location with modern infrastructure, efficient layouts, quality finishes, professional property management, and strong security, while also incorporating sustainability features and more efficient, lower-waste construction methods. Its premium build and thoughtful design support modern ways of working while helping businesses attract and retain top talent.

The 11-storey project offers over 25,000 square meters of gross leasable area, expansive 2,700 square-meter floor plates, column-free spaces, EV-charging provision, ample parking, and sustainability features, with LEED certification being pursued. Its design also reflects a strong sense of place, with glass patterns inspired by Mount Apo and podium details that take cues from the shapes and patterns of traditional festival attire in Mindanao.

“Through Cybergate Victoria, Robinsons Land continues to express its confidence in the long-term promise of Mindanao,” said Ms. Mybelle V. Aragon GoBio. She adds that by bringing premium, professionally managed office spaces to growth centers such as Davao, the company aims to help raise business standards, support job creation, and contribute to better opportunities and improved quality of life across the region.
